answer_1.quote: Coherence models that can evaluate machine-generated text have become the need of the hour.
answer_1.outputs: The paper addresses generated outputs in summarization and machine translation, evaluating their coherence using proposed models.

answer_2.quote: traditional metrics such as BLEU and ROUGE are unable to measure text quality and readability

answer_4.quote: We conducted a user study on Amazon Mechanical Turk. Workers were instructed about the concept of coherence and shown examples of coherent and incoherent texts.
answer_4.guideline: Workers were instructed about the concept of coherence and shown examples of coherent and incoherent texts. Given the prompt, they were asked to choose the more coherent text out of two given language model outputs; they were also given an option to choose neither in case the texts were equally coherent/incoherent.
